title: Dutch Skillet Paninis
description: A simple and quick recipe to make delicious paninis with Dutch cheese and Emmentaler cheese.
instructions: 1. Preheat the skillet to medium-high heat.
2. Butter one side of each slice of cheese.
3. Place one slice of cheese, butter side down, in the preheated skillet.
4. Place a slice of Emmentaler cheese on top of the Dutch cheese.
5. Sprinkle some light breading on top of the Emmentaler cheese for a crispy crust.
6. Cook for 2-3 minutes or until the cheese is melted and the breading is golden brown.
7. Flip the panini over and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes or until the other side is also golden brown.
8. Repeat with the remaining cheese slices and breading.
